# Find Horse Professionals Near You!

# Horse Pro Finder — _your_ premiere equine professional directory

Find a qualified horse professional FAST at _Horse Pro Finder_ — _the_ premiere equine business, services, and events directory! _Horse Pro Finder_ locates equine professionals near you within seconds, complete with full contact information, photos, reviews, a Geo-Located map and more!

[![Find a Farrier](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/hpf_banner_farrier_hotshoe-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find A Farrier**](https://horseprofinder.com/farriers)

**Looking for a local farrier?** Whether you are seeking a farrier that specializes in dressage, hunter/jumper, western pleasure, reining, gaited, or therapeutic and corrective shoeing, we can help find a qualified farrier near you!

[![Find a Horse Trainer](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/cat-horse-training-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find A Trainer**](https://horseprofinder.com/trainers)

**Looking for a local horse trainer?** Find a qualified equine trainer near you who specializes in everything from dressage, hunter/jumper and saddleseat to trail riding and barrel racing. Find the perfect local horse trainer for you!

[![Find a Horse Competition](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/HorseCompetition-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find Shows**](https://horseprofinder.com/competitions)

**Looking for a local horse show, equine competition?** Get in the game! Find a local dressage, hunter/jumper, saddleseat show, halter competition, rodeo, barrel-race, or even a local polo match near you with Horse Pro Finder.

[![Find a Stable](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/cat-stable-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find A Stable**](https://horseprofinder.com/stables)

**Looking for a local Boarding Barn?** Find a quality stable near you that specializes in boarding, breeding, training, dressage, eventing, western pleasure, reining, or showing. If you can imagine your dream stable, we can find it!

[![Find Guided Trail Rides](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/cat-trail-rides-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find Trial Rides**](https://horseprofinder.com/guided-trail-rides)

**Looking for local Guided Trail Rides?** Find a fun and memorable guided trail ride near you. We can help you find your next equine adventure over the hills, through the streams, down the trails for the ride of your dreams!

[![Find Equine Insurance](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/cat-insurance-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find Insurance**](https://horseprofinder.com/equine-insurance)

**Looking for Equine Insurance Agents and Companies?** Find an equine insurance professional that can cover your "saddle", your horse, and even _you_ when you're on or off of the saddle!

[![](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/hpf_banner_vet-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find a Vet**](https://horseprofinder.com/vets)

**Looking for a local veterinarian?** Whether you are looking for a vet or vet clinic that specializes in emergency procedures, large and small animals, or equine dentistry, you can find a qualified vet or vet clinic near you!

[![Find a Riding Instructor](ttps://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/cat-show-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find Lessons**](https://horseprofinder.com/instructors)

**Looking for a local Lessons?** Have you gotten in a rut with your riding skills? Find a qualified instructor near you who specializes in giving lessons on dressage, hunter/jumper, western pleasure, casual trail riding, and more!

[![Find an Event](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/cat-events-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find Events**](https://horseprofinder.com/events)

**Interested in attending a local horse event?** Whether you are looking for a group trail ride, a training clinic, or a saddle club event, we have you covered! If you are looking for a local equine event near you, check out our list!

[![Find a Tack Store](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/cat-tack-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find Tack**](https://horseprofinder.com/tack)

**Looking for a local tack store?** Whether you are seeking a quality saddle, show apparel, inexpensive bridle, nutritious feed and supplements, or even training equipment, we have a local friendly tack store that can supply your needs!

[![Find a Photographer](https://horseprofinder.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/cat-photography-1024x576.jpg)\\
\\
**Find A Photographer**](https://horseprofinder.com/photography)

**Looking for a local photographer?** Whether you want to have your favorite steed photographed or get those awesome action shots of you riding, jumping, or eventing, we can help find the perfect photographer or videographer!
